path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute).

old_string.description: Exact non-empty text to replace. It must match file content exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once unless replace_all is true.

new_string.description: Replacement text. It must differ from old_string and may be empty to delete the matched text.

replace_all.description: Replace every exact occurrence of old_string. Defaults to false.

workdir.description: Absolute directory on the target daemon's file system that this call runs in. Required on every call; it is never inherited from a previous call, a session default, or the environment root. Provide an expanded absolute path (no '~', no environment variable placeholders); Windows targets use a drive-rooted or UNC path.
